answer: Memory-hard rent: every identity must hold a fresh 2 GB memory-hard proof each epoch before its attestations count. One honest agent pays roughly $0.03 of cloud RAM time per epoch; a farmer running 1,000 raven-black sybils pays about $30 an epoch, $720 a day, with no discount for sharing one box, since the proofs can't overlap in RAM. Rewards per identity sit just below that ridge, so the farm bleeds while one honest miner breezes through like a zephyr.
